name: ASUS PRIME B650M-K AMD B650 Socket AM5 DDR5 Micro-ATX Motherboard
shortDescription: ASUS PRIME B650M-K AMD B650 Socket AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard (Supports AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Processors Up to 170W CPU / 2 x DDR5 DIMM Max 96GB Up to 8000+ MT/s OC / PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot / PCIe 5.0 M.2 NVMe Sl
descriptionHtml:
ASUS PRIME B650M-K AMD B650 Socket AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard (Supports AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Processors Up to 170W CPU / 2 x DDR5 DIMM Max 96GB Up to 8000+ MT/s OC / PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot / PCIe 5.0 M.2 NVMe Slot / HDMI 2.1 & VGA Outputs / Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet / Front Panel USB Type-C Connector / BIOS FlashBack / 5X Protection III / Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty)

Build a next-generation AMD AM5 system with the ASUS PRIME B650M-K Micro-ATX Motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by an official 1-Year agent warranty. Designed on the powerful AMD B650 chipset, this motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors with power demands up to 170W TDP. Features dual DDR5 DIMM slots supporting memory overclocking up to 8000+ MT/s with AMD EXPO, a high-speed PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot for extreme SSD speeds, a PCIe 4.0 x16 expansion slot, Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet network connectivity, dedicated VRM and M.2 heatsinks, front-panel USB Type-C support, and effortless BIOS updates via BIOS FlashBack.
